blind_spots.blind_spot: cUAS detection products with no path into the common operating picture
blind_spots.operator_reality: EchoDome/EchoGuard alerts that don't publish to ATAK/TAK or the base defense operations center are a screen nobody watches; a passive acoustic warning that can't cue the counter-UAS kill chain in low-bandwidth conditions is a demo, not a defense — and TAK never appears in their materials.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team heritage is CV/ML software (Anno Vision) and their two open roles are both ML engineers; nobody owns tactical-network integration.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: EchoGuard - cUAS Passive Drone Detection Platform

blind_spots.operator_reality: A TRL-7 demonstration on Lake Superior does not survive contact with RMF: connecting range telemetry, sensor feeds, and labeled data to any DoD network needs an ATO package their language never acknowledges — the transition dies in accreditation months, not testing weeks.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Their business model is selling readiness-level progression, so readiness level is the metric they think in; acquisition-side gates aren't their customer conversation yet.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: consist of testing and monitoring infrastructure to accelerate the Technical Readiness Level (TRL) of new autonomous UV platforms

blind_spots.blind_spot: Advertising harsh-environment testing with no sustainment staffing
blind_spots.operator_reality: Shore, surface, and lakebed sensor infrastructure through a Duluth winter needs field technicians, spares, and recovery crews on payroll; a 13-person company hiring only ML engineers will watch its own range instrumentation go dark in exactly the 'extreme cold and wind conditions' it sells.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The pivot to physical infrastructure is recent; the org chart still reflects the software company they were.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Provides rigorous testing in extreme cold and wind conditions.

opener_hook: Anno's EchoGuard won a USAF Phase I in 2025, yet both open roles are ML engineers — nobody is posted for the field work of keeping passive acoustic arrays alive through the Duluth winters the site advertises as a feature.
what_they_do: Runs autonomous-vehicle test ranges (Lake Superior Test Range) and builds passive acoustic drone/threat detection sensors under USAF SBIRs.
